data.intro: Recording the match is easy. Finding one goal, save or turning point inside an hour of footage is the part most teams never get around to. Pitchside's football video analysis workflow is designed to reduce that search. Record or upload suitable footage, let the private-beta system process the match, then review the supported stats, highlights and player output it returns.

faqs.question: Can I upload an existing football match video?
faqs.answer: Suitable existing footage may work when it meets the available upload requirements and gives the system a stable, useful view. Publish the confirmed file, duration and format requirements before launch.
Pitchside is designed to process the footage and identify supported events. Users should still review the returned output and correct or report errors through the approved product workflow.
faqs.question: Do I need to tag the video manually?

faqs.answer: The launch product is player and grassroots-team focused. It helps regular groups review match output, stats and highlights. It is not positioned as a full professional tactical-analysis suite.
faqs.question: Is this football video analysis app for coaches or players?
Can I download the original recording?
faqs.answer: Do not answer this until the retention, download and storage policy is confirmed. Link to Security & Data when the details are approved.

faqs.question: Is the result instant?
faqs.answer: No. Upload and processing can currently take up to 45 minutes during private beta.

data.heroH1: From a full match video to the moments you need to analyze.

contentBlocks.content: Before upload: decide whether the footage is usable
Football video analysis software cannot recover an event the camera never saw.
Before uploading, check the basics:

items: The match is recorded in landscape orientation.
The phone is stable and positioned above head height.
The playing area remains visible for most of the game.
Fencing, substitutes and spectators do not repeatedly block the view.
The file contains the complete match section you want analysed.
Players and kits are visible enough to distinguish where possible.

contentBlocks.content: One phone can work for a compact pitch. Two phones are preferred when one view loses too much detail at the far end. Use the full recording guide before your first match.
Upload the match without doing the tagging yourself
Traditional video analysis often begins with someone watching the whole recording and marking every event by hand.

Pitchside uses the video as the source and processes it after upload. The current system is testing supported events such as goals, assists, saves, passes and tackles. These can feed the Match Stats & Highlights, Personal Stats, leaderboards and Paid Personal Clips experience.
During private beta, uploading and processing can currently take up to 45 minutes. Connection speed, file size, recording length and the developing workflow can affect the time.
Review what Pitchside found
The review screen should make three things clear:

items: The moment: where it sits in the recording.
The assignment: which team or player is connected to it, where supported.

contentBlocks.content: The product should not force a user to trust a number without context. Opening the related footage is part of the review.
This is also where the page needs real product evidence. A static list of capabilities is less convincing than one complete beta match with the output visible.
Correct before you share or compare
AI-assisted output can be wrong. A tackle may be missed, a save may be assigned to the wrong player or an event may be hidden behind another player.

The approved product flow should let the reviewer correct supported output or clearly report a problem. Until that workflow is live, the site must describe beta results as reviewable rather than final.
Do not publish the sentence “the app records your stats automatically” without the review qualification. A more accurate promise is:
Pitchside analyses suitable match footage and returns supported stats and moments for review.
Use the output in three different ways
Review the match
Move from the full recording to the moments that changed the game.
Keep the record
Connect supported Match Stats and Personal Stats to the footage behind them.
Share the moment
Use available Match Highlights or Paid Personal Clips after checking recording consent and league rules.
Read the recording consent and privacy guidance before publishing footage.
This is not professional analyst software in a smaller box
Some football video analysis software is built for coaches who want tactical coding, live tagging, opposition analysis and full-pitch review. Pitchside's launch focus is different.
It is designed around phone-recorded small-sided matches and player-facing outputs: stats, highlights, leaderboards and personal records.

Teams that require an established tactical platform, live broadcast or guaranteed panoramic master should choose a system built for that job. Compare the options on Best Veo Alternative for Grassroots Football.
Plans and recording allowances
Free: one recording per month, Match Stats & Highlights, Leaderboards and Personal Stats.
Paid: one recording per week, everything in Free and Personal Clips. £4.99 weekly, £12.99 monthly or £99 annually.
